JSON parsing

JSON is a text data format. JSON.parse converts JSON text into JavaScript values; JSON.stringify serializes
supported values. Invalid JSON throws a SyntaxError.
Server එJකන් එන JSON text එක JS object එකකට convert කරන්න parse() භාවිත කරනවා. Object එක JSON text කරන්න stringify() භාවිත කරනවා. JSON වල double quotes සහ valid syntax අවශ්‍යයි.

Interview question: Can JSON serialize every JS value?

Answer: No. Functions and undefined are omitted from object properties; cycles and BigInt normally
throw.
Practice: Try parsing invalid JSON and catch SyntaxError.
